page.layout: One printed page, a list of Jesuit colleges with braces at the left margin and a few labels beside the braces. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Signature at foot centre.

main_text.head: 5. PROVINCIA ARAGONENSIS.
4. PROVINCIA BAETICA.
main_text.p: Labels beside the braces: Collegium (Segobiense group), Valetiae, Collegium (Barcinonense group), Hispali.

page.notes: Braces at the left margin group the colleges under the labels "Collegium", "Valetiae", "Collegium" and "Hispali". The brace labels are small and partly faint. Some lines near the top are faint from show-through. Division numbers 5 and 4 are printed as shaped numerals and read as such.
